name: comp-587
blurb: Icon navbar with app shortcuts, notifications, and upgrade button.
description: Header with icon navigation menu, app switcher menu (multiple apps), notifications, user dropdown, and highlighted upgrade button.
use_when: Product suites or multi-app platforms where users need quick app switching.
avoid_when: Single-app experiences; app switcher adds visual weight.
a11y: Icons have aria-label or sr-only. App menu managed with aria-expanded. Upgrade button is semantic.
